Keep Control FAB and Control Panel as the secondary app layer, do not change GoMesh or Control Plane behavior for visual polish, and avoid nested cards, decorative blobs/orbs, one-note blue/purple themes, overlap, horizontal overflow and unreadable Russian strings. Return screenshots/evidence for desktop and mobile where tools are available.
role_goal: raise Kolibri landing/app presentation to the premium UI standard without weakening product usability

forbidden: GoMesh or Control Plane behavior changes for visuals
